title: Database migration this Saturday night
text:
Hi Wop,

Heads up: I'm planning a database migration this Saturday, October 17, from 11 PM to 1 AM Eastern.

Why: the matching service v0.3 stores each student's free time in a new format, and the old tables can't handle it. Moving now means we don't have to do it after the Nov 2 launch, when far more students will be using the app.

What to expect:
- The Pairly app will show a "We'll be right back" screen for up to 2 hours
- No data should be lost. I'm taking a full backup before I start.
- If anything goes wrong, I can roll back to the backup in about 15 minutes

Could you send a short notice to the Westbrook beta testers on Friday? Tomás can share it in the campus group chat too.

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
CTO, Pairly
